iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PROFILE::tftp
       Returns the value of an TFTP profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::tftp ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned TFTP profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned TFTP profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
